name: fashion_mnist_150
description: A small subset drawn from the Fashion-MNIST image classification benchmark, likely intended for few-shot or rapid evaluation experiments. Measures basic visual object classification performance on common clothing categories. Useful as a simple, low-resource benchmark for vision models and sanity checks.
reputation: Based on the well-known Fashion-MNIST benchmark; widely used for educational purposes and quick vision baselines but not considered a challenging research benchmark.
